feed.title: Electrical & Electronics — Useful Sites
feed.subtitle: An annotated directory of links on software, AI, security and science. Every entry states what the resource does and where it parts ways with its neighbours.

entry.title: Awesome CircuitPython
entry.summary: A list of libraries and projects for Python on microcontrollers (CircuitPython). Unlike general embedded lists it focuses on programming hardware in Python rather than C.

entry.title: Awesome Electronics
entry.summary: A list of tools, manufacturers and communities for electronics engineers and hobbyists. Unlike general hardware lists it focuses on PCB design, component sourcing and simulation.

entry.title: Awesome ESP
entry.summary: A list of libraries and projects for the ESP8266/ESP32, cheap microcontrollers with WiFi. Unlike general embedded lists it focuses on this chip family and wireless projects.

entry.title: Adafruit Learn
entry.summary: Step-by-step, illustrated guides for microcontroller, sensor and electronics projects. Unlike product pages it carries the part you bought all the way to a working project.

entry.title: All About Circuits
entry.summary: Free lessons, calculators and a forum teaching electrical and electronics from the ground up. Unlike scattered videos it progresses in textbook order from DC to digital design.

entry.title: Falstad Circuit Simulator
entry.summary: A simulator that lets you draw a circuit in the browser and shows current and voltage as a live animation. Unlike static schematics you see how the electrons flow in real time — for intuition.

entry.title: SparkFun Learn
entry.summary: A tutorial library for electronics basics and embedded projects. Similar to Adafruit; it leans more into foundational concepts like soldering, power and communication protocols.
